title: Practice: Should Our School Start Later?
question: Should middle schools start later in the morning?

sources.title: How Much Sleep Teens Need
sources.excerpt:
Recommended sleep for ages 13 to 18: "8 to 10 hours per 24 hours."

According to data from 2025, 75% of students are not getting adequate sleep.
sources.citation: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, "Sleep and Health," Healthy Schools, updated September 2026.

sources.title: What Doctors Recommend About Start Times
sources.note: Key facts from the same page.
sources.excerpt:
In 2014, the American Academy of Pediatrics recommended that middle and high schools start "no earlier than 8:30 AM."

The page says late bedtimes plus early start times leave most teens short on sleep.
sources.citation: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, "Sleep and Health," Healthy Schools, updated September 2026.

sources.title: Find a Source for the Other Side
sources.note: Counterpoint practice: who might disagree with a later start (families, coaches, bus planners)? Find one source that gives their reasons and log it.
